description: A helper script for managing Docker containers and configurations related to OpenClaw, including functions for starting, stopping, updating, and configuring the environment, as well as user guidance commands.

methods.name: _clr_cmd
methods.description: Outputs styled command text in green and bold.

methods.name: _cmd
methods.description: Outputs inline command text in green and bold.

methods.name: _clawdock_filter_warnings
methods.description: Filters out warning and timing lines from logs.

methods.name: _clawdock_trim_quotes
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string.

methods.name: _clawdock_mask_value
methods.description: Redacts sensitive values, showing length or placeholder.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_config_dir
methods.description: Reads the configuration directory from the config file.

methods.name: _clawdock_ensure_dir
methods.description: Ensures the Docker environment directory is set and valid.

methods.name: _clawdock_compose
methods.description: Runs docker compose commands with the correct configuration files.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_env_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from the environment file.
